map.珍珠品质分级标准 使用指南: Pearl Quality Grading Standard User Guide
map.依据光泽、光洁度、形状、颜色与大小五大要素对珍珠品质打分，按各维度权重综合评定等: Scores pearl quality on five elements - luster, surface smoothness, shape, color and size - and combines the per-dimension weights into a grade with a stated grading basis, suited to selection, appraisal or teaching reference.
map.按多维度给珍珠定级，判断价值。: Grade pearls across multiple dimensions and judge value.
map.对比不同等级的外观差异。: Compare the appearance differences between levels.
map.：以光泽为主、瑕疵形状匹配为辅：4 级最强光泽近乎镜面、5 无瑕级稀少；3 级强: Luster first, blemish shape match second: grade 4 has the strongest near-mirror luster, and the flawless grade 5 is very rare; grade 3 is strong luster with minor blemishes, grade 2 moderate, grade 1 weak luster with visible blemishes. The higher the grade the rarer and more valuable.
map.：多珠首饰额外看大小/色/光的匹配度；同串偏差小(匹配 4 级)比单珠等级更影响: For multi-stone jewelry also weigh the match of size, color and luster; a strand with small deviation (match grade 4) affects overall value more than the grade of a single stone.
map.光泽为什么最重要？: Why is luster the most important?
map.光泽(晕彩)是珍珠灵魂，强光泽可弥补微瑕；瑕疵不可逆但可被设计与镶嵌遮，故分级以: Luster (iridescence) is the soul of a pearl, and strong luster can make up for small blemishes; blemishes are irreversible but can be hidden by design and mounting, so grading puts luster first.
map.→ 打开珍珠品质分级标准工具: → Open the Pearl Grading (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.按光泽、光洁度、形状、颜色和品种内尺寸做固定权重参考评分，输出 AAA 等参考档: Fixed-weight reference score from luster, surface, shape, color and size within the selected variety, mapped to AAA and similar reference bands. It is a subjective shopping reference, not a GIA/NGTC grading certificate.
map.综合评分 = 光泽×35% + 光洁度×25% + 形状×15% + 颜色×15: Total = luster×35% + surface×25% + shape×15% + color×15% + size×10%. Size is scored only relative to the usual size range of the chosen variety (Akoya, South Sea, Tahitian, freshwater, other), and millimetre counts are not compared across varieties.
map.按光泽、光洁度、形状、颜色与品种内尺寸做选购对比。: Compare pearls for shopping by luster, surface, shape, color and size within the same variety.
map.理解本站固定权重评分与 AAA 参考档的局限，不把它当鉴定证书。: Understand the limits of this fixed-weight score and AAA reference band; do not treat it as a grading certificate.
map.参考评分怎么来: How the reference score is built
map.：按固定权重（光泽 35%、光洁度 25%、形状 15%、颜色 15%、大小 1: : The fixed weights (luster 35%, surface 25%, shape 15%, color 15%, size 10%) add up to a 0–4 score, which maps to AAA, AA+ and other reference bands. Size is converted only within the chosen variety's usual range.
map.为什么不是鉴定: Why this is not an appraisal
map.：同一颗珍珠在不同机构、不同分级口径下可能得到不同结论；本页没有实物检测、珠层厚: : The same pearl can receive different conclusions from different laboratories and grading schemes. This page has no physical inspection, nacre-thickness measurement or certificate, so it can only be a subjective shopping reference.
map.本页没有实物检测、珠层厚度和证书信息，不能据此判定收藏或拍卖价值；同颗珍珠在不同: This page has no physical testing, nacre thickness or certificate information and cannot establish collector or auction value. The same pearl can also receive different conclusions from different laboratories and grading schemes.
map.按常见分级体系，瑕疵分无瑕 / 微瑕 / 少瑕 / 有瑕 / 多瑕，正圆无瑕极罕: Under common grading systems, surface is classed as flawless / very slight / slight / noticeable / obvious. A round, flawless pearl is extremely rare and prices rise steeply. A practical test is social distance: blemishes invisible at about 50 cm in normal conversation are perfectly acceptable for daily wear and usually the best value; perfect surfaces often cost about twice as much. Blemishes near the drill hole and on the back matter far less than on the face.
map.AAA 就是最好的珍珠吗？: Does AAA mean the best pearl?
map.不是。AAA 只是本页固定权重算出的参考档，不代表 GIA/NGTC 等机构证书: No. AAA is only the reference band produced by this page's fixed weights. It is not a GIA/NGTC certificate grade and cannot establish collector or auction value; real value also depends on variety, nacre, live luster and matching.
